scope: Existing review questions; source limitations retained; no new human approvals

records.answer: The paper has an empirical case-study basis: methods on PDF p13 describe Zambia surveys of 182 households (2002) and 197 households (2005), plus a separate Honduras case. The specific p18 extension statement is the authors’ qualitative interpretation of the Zambia case, without an isolated extension coefficient or experimental comparison. Retain case-study guidance, not a quantified causal finding or default weight.

This is the only active land-cover model-use record from Chuma. The richer-looking Table 3 extraction is already dropped. Dropping this record would lose the evidence that land use/cover entered the model. Retained it as model-use only, with no invented class scores or weight. Source-level counting still counts Chuma once; table values require separate verified extraction.

Confirmed secondary attribution. Dias-Filho cites Pagiola et al. (2004), Paying for biodiversity conservation services, World Bank Environment Department Papers, Environmental and Economic Series 96 (bibliography PDF p24). Pages 15–16 discuss initial investment and delayed returns, not a measured credit-access coefficient. Retain the citation chain and economic-return timing; no additional independent original-paper vote until original extraction is verified.

Confirmed: this paper models sheep/goat grazing in a Jordan steppe reserve, not silvopasture establishment. Corrected the variable from roads to distance to waterbody: methods derive Euclidean distance to DEM-derived streams. The table prints unit M with cutoffs <1, 1–3, 3–5 and >5; no kilometre conversion inferred. Parked as contextual candidate, outside executable agroforestry rules. Your GLW4 host-mask proposal is a separate design choice, not evidence supplied by this paper.

PCU means Potential for Conservation Use: a composite of slope (50%), soil class (39%) and lithology (11%), defined on PDF p4. Its cutoff of 3 partitions regional agrosilvopastoral aptitude versus conservation priority; it is not a land-cover category or an independent soil/slope threshold. Corrected variable identity and removed generic threshold encoding. Record remains dropped; retained the source method for audit without counting the composite alongside its inputs.

The quoted 20–30°C and >1200 mm assertion cites Ahmad, Uddin & Goparaju (2019), Agroforestry suitability mapping of India geospatial approach based on FAO guidelines (PDF bibliography p19). It occurs inside a mulberry study; the next sentence gives separate growing-season mulberry temperature classes. Retain the attributed regional statement, with mean annual and growing-season temperature kept distinct. Neither this quote nor the species-specific model weight establishes a universal agroforestry envelope. Original Ahmad claim remains unverified.

This is a modelled financial-return explanation for French silvoarable scenarios using walnut/poplar, not a market-access measurement. Corrected variable to economic return and retained it in operational/implementation guidance. The full sentence cites Graves et al. (in press); no price, distance, market-depth threshold or transferable return is established by this passage. It supports considering species economics in next steps.

This is a systematic-review finding, not merely opinion. But the land-access statement comes from the qualitative synthesis, not the meta-analysis effect estimate (which concerns information access). PDF pp27 and 30 explain the split and list land-access evidence from Cechin et al. (2021), Vosti et al. (1997), and Bezerra et al. (2018). Corrected variable to land access, distinct from tenure security; removed the unsupported negative coefficient interpretation. Retain secondary implementation guidance with no isolated effect size.

Methods identify NBSS-LUP regional soil resource data derived from ground surveys/Land Resource Inventory (PDF p4), and reuse the Singh 2022 model (p5). Table 1 gives Very well / Well / Mod well but no water-table, saturation-duration or hydraulic thresholds. Low class is a dash, not proven unsuitable. Retained source labels and ordinal preference; exact dataset edition/legend and target crosswalk remain required before execution. No invented numerical boundaries.
